scope: Bevar samme OpenCode-session ved Planlæg → Byg, når konto, model, rute, motorversion, arbejdsmappe, referenceadgang og instruktioner er uændrede. Genstart stadig motoren med den nye tilladelsespolitik.
proofKind: Core integration tests with a synthetic engine and a controlled loopback model catalog; no production model inference.

before.test: Planlæg til godkendt Byg genstarter tilladelsespolitikken og bevarer samme modelsession
before.result: failed as expected on unmodified original core

compatibility.legacySessionPolicy: One new model session when a saved record lacks the new binding. Local messages, plan and draft are kept. Subsequent normal reopen resumes only an exact modern binding.

coverage: plan revision and stale plan/review rejection
connection-id change with equal legacy metadata
notClaimed: Production model or real account acceptance
GitHub Actions or green hosted CI
Content hashing or new Privacy Gate checks for reference file contents
